location_exception_reason: Aluminium structures are prefabricated industrial/construction components with standardised specifications (alloy grade, temper, wind load compliance per IS:875). Location of manufacture or seller does not alter the product's functional attributes or buyer decision logic; buyers select by structural type (solar mounting, canopy, truss), load rating, and alloy grade, not origin.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Fabricator, Contractor) in titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Aluminium Solar Structure Manufacturer' leaves the product complete and accurate — the product is still an aluminium solar structure regardless of who fabricates it.
